'''Olom Roskom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and the owner of [[Roskom Mechanized Systems]], the main maintenance contractor of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|imperial]] [[Trivar II Imperial Detention Center|detention center]] in [[Glare Peak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trivar II/Legends|Trivar II]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Rescue at Glare Peak" />
